notes.title: Halve DEMO Patch Notes V0.3.7
notes.notes:
[p]Next Fest has officially begun, and together with that, we have released a new update for the Demo!
Once again, huge thanks for your feedback, it's helping us shape the game for the better!!

- Reworked both character hands orbs VFX - better visuals and performance![/p][p]- Entering the cave at the end of each level will now automatically trigger the level end sequence.[/p][p]- Steam Deck improvements: disabled unnecessary graphics settings, fixed UI navigation with D-Pad issues and B (cancel) button not working for UI navigation, and disabled touchscreen controls.[/p][p]- Increased UI Sliders step value, as some of you had issues changing the audio while using joysticks[/p][p]- Fixed Brightness setting not being visually reflected in the Main Menu.[/p][p]- Fixed music disappearance when coming back to the Main Menu from any level.[/p][p]- Fixed Steam session not exiting properly for some players on Windows 11.[/p][p]- Some small overall performance improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun with the Demo![/p]

notes.title: Halve DEMO Patch Notes v0.3.6
notes.notes:
Thank you for the feedback and bug reports so far! Here are the first demo patch notes:

- Slightly adjusted camera framing for square-ish displays to follow the players better (4:3 aspect ratio).
- Mouse cursor is now hidden while in-game
- The final demo challenge sequence no longer loses its awesome music when skipping the cutscene.
- Fixed characters sometimes sliding on the ground and losing their movement animations after a cutscene.
- Fixed Graphics Screen Resolution settings having duplicate entries.
- Fixed an edge case where the collected secrets count would get reset (Sorry for that! You can now search for all the secrets successfully, hopefully 👀).
- Fixed an issue that breaks/freezes the game when returning to the main menu screen while in the level restart sequence

Let us know if you notice any more issues or have any suggestions on what we could adjust! Thanks, and have fun with the demo!

notes.title: A brand new HALVE Demo released!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We’re back after a looong time of silence - really sorry about that!! 🙇 We were laser-focused on Halve, making progress every single day to bring you something exciting - a short gameplay demo that showcases the beginning of the game! The HALVE Demo is available NOW on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391460/Halve_Demo/?utm_source=Announcement]Steam Demo page[/url]!

Check out the trailer below:
[previewyoutube=E1mRO5Nmfi0;full][/previewyoutube]

Over the past few months, we have spent countless hours polishing everything, updating each level, and fixing as many bugs as possible to bring you the best game we could. By the way, it would mean a lot if you actually left a review for us on the Demo page if you end up trying it out, as we really want to know if the experience was enjoyable to you 💙

Also, since our team is very small, we most likely didn’t manage to catch every single glitch, bug, or issue while working on the game, so if you notice something that is off, broken, or just have any suggestions, join our [url=https://discord.gg/n5KTcke4vr]Community Discord server[/url] and share your feedback with us! That was way beyond exciting, as we got to talk with so many players and fans alike, and see how each and every one of you reacted to the game. If you would like to try catching us at one of these expos, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/n5KTcke4vr]Discord server[/url], as we share all the updates regarding events there as well!

notes.title: Halve Devlog #0
notes.notes:
Hey hey!

Welcome to our very first Devlog of Halve - the puzzle platformer where you have to control two characters at once! 
Our plan with these Devlogs is to showcase you, our players, the development process, and how we tackle different development scenarios. 

I'm Airidas, a Game Designer/Developer from the Moonleaf studio, and I will try my best to post these updates at least once a month, so if you're interested in learning more about behind the scene's stuff, join me for a ride!

[h1]The Team[/h1]
As this is the initial Devlog, I think that it's only natural that I should introduce the people who are working their hardest to make the game a reality.

We are Moonleaf studio, a small group of Indie Developers from Lithuania. We have been working on different game ideas in the past, but none were as ambitious as Halve!

There are four of us in total at the moment:
[list]
[*] I'm the Glowing Things guy with a Twist. In other words, I do Game design for the project, as well as VFX Art and develop some stuff here and there
[*] Eligijus is our Code magician - he does everything related to those 1's and 0s to make the game work behind the scenes.
[*] Migle is the Visionary Mastermind. She brings all the visions to life with her mesmerizing concepts and creative vision.
[*] Gantas is, as we like to call him, the Vertex king. He's a madman who can do anything that's related to 3D stuff. Oh yeah, and he does environments as well.
[/list]
Long story short, we're a team who are extremely passionate about everything game related. For instance, we keep on getting involved in Game Jams ever since the first day we tried out the competition. I can't even remember how many projects I was a part of during these events.

[h1]Halve[/h1]
It's actually quite a funny story to how we even got to the point of creating Halve. 
Since we love taking part in Game Jam competitions, and we did just that about a year and a half ago - we took part in the Global Game Jam 2022. The Theme for that year was Duality - and you can probably already see where this is going by now :D. We brainstormed loads of ideas, bashed them together, and got the inspiration to create something similar to an old flash Co-op game Fireboy and Watergirl, just with a unique twist. Which was to make the game single-player, where the player would have to control both of the characters at the same time.

[h1]Devlog #0[/h1]
There were actually some other nuances as well - so if you'd like to know more about the story, and how we actually went from the small Game Jam prototype to where we are now, be sure to check out the Devlog video down below!

[previewyoutube=l1oQIZCL8co;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for reading, and I hope you will join us on this journey of discovering the secrets of Halve!

Cheers,
Airidas

notes.title: Halve Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello adventure seekers!

We have some exciting news for you today - we have finally decided to release Halve Steam demo on April 21st!

The Demo will consist of two chapters, where you will be able to experience a variety of mind-bending challenges in the world of Halve. If you're curious to see all the content that will be available, it should take you up to half an hour to complete all of the demo levels.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1906430/Halve/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1906430/extras/Environments.gif?t=1678549909[/img][/url]

Here are some of the features that will be included in the first Demo version:
[list]
[*] Simultaneous movement of two characters - control both of the spirits at the same time by using the same movement keys to navigate through the world!
[*] Two environments - Forest and Ruins. Both environments will allow you to experience hand-crafted challenging levels and beautiful scenery!
[*] Unique character abilities - the final game will consist of many different and unique character abilities, and so during the Demo, you will be able to use two of these powers to solve more difficult challenges!
[*] Up to 20 short levels, where every level will introduce you to different possible encounters of Halve!
[*] Three mesmerizing and original soundtracks - Main game theme, Forest and Ruins chapters.
[*] And some additional features as well! (That I don't want to spoil you guys, so I'm not going to mention them here, haha!)
[/list]
And for this occasion, we have opened up a Discord server! You are more than welcome to join if you'd like to give us any kind of feedback, or just chat about anything game related!

[url=https://discord.gg/n5KTcke4vr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941412/e370168dd8e07bc2fdae99cf7f1c9c0ee81cc73e.png[/img][/url]

Talk to you soon! 
Cheers!
- The Moonleaf studio team
